product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)

honesty.districts: district names are public-record identities only; every record is a PROPOSED partner - no district has reviewed or agreed, and no agreement exists
honesty.certification: nothing in the school program certifies equipment operation; the assessment gates demand unaided verification and simulator hours never count toward certification

model.name: gamified flipped classroom
model.loop: explore at home, build and practice in class, verify unaided; the teacher circulates instead of lecturing

stages.title: Explore at home
stages.what: the lesson positions of the module pack, sequenced by the skill graph with the ZPD difficulty dial, in any of the eight shipped languages
stages.gamified: module layers and pipeline states are the map the learner explores; progress is visible per hall

stages.title: Build in class
stages.what: station bench work - checklists, doctrine lines and machine-gradable quizzes at the hall stations, with the teacher moving bench to bench
stages.gamified: station beacons in the 3D hall; completion marks accumulate on the hall roster

stages.title: Practice on the floor
stages.what: simulator seat time with the regional scenario of the campus - live dash, synthesized sound, deterministic rubric; results and best times persist device-locally
stages.gamified: pass/retry chips, best-time records, cockpit views

stages.title: Verify unaided
stages.what: assessment gates certify only unaided work; no home exploration, class bench or simulator hour substitutes for the unaided verification run
stages.implemented_by: the assessment-gate protocol (ACP-04) and the sims registry honesty note
stages.gamified: nothing - the gate is deliberately ungamified, and the model says so

bands.offer: awareness only: the campus maps, the walkable halls and the city layers; no machine seats and no station quizzes
home modules at fundamentals tier plus class station work
applied-tier modules, stations, and simulator floor time with the regional scenario
mastery-tier modules, full flipped loop, and the unaided verification gate
